class.name: BehaviorTreeReactiveSequence
class.brief_description: Rechecks every child in sequence on each tick, aborting invalidated running tasks.
class.description: Like [BehaviorTreeSequence], returns [constant BehaviorTreeTask.FAILURE] when a guard fails, [constant BehaviorTreeTask.RUNNING] when a task runs, or [constant BehaviorTreeTask.SUCCESS] after all children succeed. Unlike the memory-based sequence, execution always restarts at the first child on each [BehaviorTreeRunner] tick, so blackboard changes can invalidate a running wait immediately. If a previously running child is preempted, its execution state is discarded. This does not undo blackboard changes or send an explicit cancellation callback to a custom script task.
